S13v20-4P6: How do you know? At each stage, always judge people based on their conduct. No matter how good it sounds when they talk about their spirituality or their therapy, don’t go by that. It’s too easy to go by vibes. It’s also easy to mistake people just doing what everyone else is doing for safety. Even giving it six months will give you more data, but there’s still no “good person” detector.
S13v20-5P4: Also agree on a mediator or ombud in advance. Why bother? People often do not trust someone who they have not met, and who appears at the time of a crisis to act as a ‘neutral stranger’. Remember that mediation is about trying to restore good relations between people. It does not remove the need for evidence, for safeguarding, for a ruling, or for a final separation when consent to continue in a shared life is no longer present.
